profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Progress Software
profile.summary:
I build high-impact solutions at the intersection of mobile development, data platforms, and AI.

My approach centers on deep technical understanding and practical problem-solving. I break down complex systems, identify the root cause, and design solutions that scale. New challenges don’t intimidate me—they’re an opportunity to learn quickly, adapt, and innovate.

I earned my B.S. in Computer Science from Brigham Young University, graduating magna cum laude with a 4.0 GPA in my major.

positions.title: Principal Engineer, TL
positions.description:
As a Team Lead, I manage a team of six engineers, providing leadership and consultation on major front-end features across web, iOS, and Android platforms. My primary focus is leveraging Flutter to build cross-platform tools, frameworks, and applications, aiming to improve developer performance, enhance user experience, and drive cost efficiency.

I serve as the lead engineer for several key features, including mobile AI chat, iOS infrastructure, Cards, App Studio Apps, and Pages. With a strong emphasis on application security, I integrate cutting-edge tools to ensure robust and secure systems.

In addition to technical contributions, I plan and manage project timelines and scope, collaborating closely with my team and manager to achieve strategic goals. A significant aspect of my role is guiding the career development of team members, fostering their growth within the organization.

I am deeply passionate about the Domo product and its transformative potential in the realms of AI and business, I enjoy contributing to its game-changing future.

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
iOS Software Engineer Team Lead
Oct 2016 - Present

Manage and organized a team of 8 engineers. Built cutting edge visualizations for customer data using UIKit, CoreData, and SceneKit. Worked in and managed a project with over 8500 files.

Web Software Engineer Team Lead
Jan 2014 - Oct 2016

Built Domo Apps for the Domo platform and Widgets for the Domo App Builder.  

Used HTML, JS, CSS, AngularJS, D3, and D3.chart to build visualizations in order to help clients view and act on their most important data.  domo.com/apps

Used AngularJS to build custom solutions for internal customers. 

Managed the scope, timeline, definition, and resources of a high visibility project that increased the scalability of our team's product.

Consulted on the architecture and implementation of internal applications and libraries.

positions.title: IOS Developer - Intern
positions.description:
Implemented mobile presentation mode of KPIs, KPI reordering, and the presentation of feature specific KPIs

Found and fixed over 30 bugs.

Gained experience diving into and working on a large foreign code project in Objective-C.

positions.title: Internet Research Assistant
positions.description:
Performed research for personal cloud solutions.

Analyzed solutions for device discover and zero configuration.

Evaluated distributed file systems such as Moose, Cloud Store, Gluster FS, Andrew, Ceph, Fraunhofer, OneFS, and Coda.

positions.title: Software Developer - Intern
positions.description:
Decoupled the Temple departments monitoring code from the core system's monitoring application to allow a more continuous deployment strategy for future code changes.

Obtained moderate proficiency with new tools such as Git, Maven, and IntelliJ.

Obtained exposure to the Spring development framework.

positions.title: Web Developer and Server/Desktop Operations Technician - Intern
positions.description:
Created solutions to application errors in the company domain for high demand customers

Developed CWI’s Vehicle Justification Web Page and rewrote 5 applications from asp to aspx

Wrote SQL stored procedures for new aspx pages

Updated 7 existing web applications to trusted connection and made requested modifications

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
Acted as the Project Manager of the Citrix Server Upgrade project and became familiar with Microsoft Project

Implemented CWI’s first Key Management Server for Microsoft Office 2010

Managed Citrix applications and Privilege Manager policies

Tested Office 2010 in company domain, created OS Images, and Auto IT scripts

Solved company member’s software and hardware problems as a Field Service Technician
